name: National Scholarship Portal: merit-cum-means scholarship
source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE SEED DATA. Criteria are simplified for the prototype and are not a substitute for the official scheme guidelines; replace before any real use.

criteria.clause_text: The applicant must be a student enrolled in a recognised institution.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000.
The applicant must have secured at least 50 percent marks in the previous examination.
The applicant must be 30 years of age or younger.
